items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: Yeah, big George. Big George Thomas, yeah, I know him, yeah.

ctx.x: I think Sidney Dazmine was working there, if I can recall. It had been so long ago, I forgot.
Do you remember pianist Thomas, George W. Thomas? Do you remember ever?
Yeah, piano player? Yes. Yeah, big George. Big George Thomas, yeah, I know him, yeah.
